sentences.text: No, the documents state that no upper limit / cap for penal charges has been prescribed for a UCB.

For a UCB, default in repayment is to be dealt with by penal charges and not penal interest, and such penal charges shall be reasonable and levied only on the amount under default in a non-discriminatory manner as per the Board approved policy.
The same UCB directions also state that additional / fresh penal charges shall not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges.
